subpages.text: Setup & Configuration Guides 15 Oct 2026 Best CCTV Company in India: How to Evaluate Brands (certification, service network, AI, pricing) There is no single best CCTV company in India. There is only the best one for your shop, school, factory, or office. This guide gives you a simple five-point check you can use on any brand: certification, service, AI, price, and range. You don’t need a technical background. Keep it open while you collect quotes. Key Takeaways Start with certification. Since 1 April 2026, internet-connected CCTV cameras must meet the government’s security rules to be sold new in India. Check the exact model, not just the brand. Test service before you buy. Call the support number, get the warranty in writing, and ask who will visit your site. Ask for an AI demo on your own premises. Useful AI means fewer, better alerts and faster footage search. Compare the full system price (cameras, recorder, storage, installation, warranty), not just the camera price. Prefer a brand whose cameras, recorders, and software are made to work together. Which CCTV company is best in India? The one that passes five checks for your site: its exact models are certified, support is real and reachable, its AI works in a live demo, the full-system price is fair, and its products fit together. A brand that passes all five is a safe shortlist. Then choose the one that suits your budget and site. Why does certification matter when choosing a CCTV company? A modern camera is a small computer on your network, so the government now checks that it can’t be easily hacked. From 1 April 2026, any connected CCTV device sold in India must meet the STQC certification standards ( The News Minute ).
